deliverables: WP1 – Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, and settlement logic
Milestone-based disbursement via TRSC and PSSC treasury management contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the Wirex project.
request.what: Bring real-world payments to Cardano with Wirex, including open-source payments infrastructure, onchain settlement smart contracts, wallet/API ecosystem layer, stablecoin-backed banking rails, compliance architecture, and Visa card issuance linked to onchain balances.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, composed of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 and 115,385 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The proposal states that Wirex will deliver full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano connecting onchain settlement to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
The proposal states that a core outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
The proposal states that Wirex has 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.
The proposal states that the work will create new transaction volume, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity onchain for Cardano.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides voting, documentation, audited-results, and audit-report references.
The proposal states that the requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

The proposal states that audit and oversight costs are included, independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, and disbursement will be milestone-based.

The proposal identifies the TRSC and PSSC addresses, the Oversight Committee entities, permission thresholds, smart-contract documentation, audit references, and a public dashboard for tracking funds onchain.
The proposal states that Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for a Wirex payments-infrastructure project administered through Intersect treasury contracts, with detailed fund-management mechanics and external references, while the main adoption and execution-capability claims are largely proposer assertions within the anchor text.
